name: ChurchTrac
shortDescription: A church management platform with people, giving, check-in, groups, service planning and optional accounting and messaging features.
suitableContexts: Churches wanting a single platform for people, giving and volunteer planning

pricing.summary: ChurchTrac prices by tracked names, with optional accounting and enhanced-messaging add-ons. The supplier’s live price selector should be checked for the church’s band.

tiers.label: Name-based subscription
tiers.detail: Price varies by number of tracked names; archived names do not count according to the supplier

tiers.label: Enhanced Messaging
tiers.detail: Optional text and voice messaging add-on; further credits can cost extra

pricing.trialDetails: 30 days free, according to the supplier.

importExport: First people import included free according to the supplier

editorial.assessment: ChurchTrac publishes a broad all-in-one feature set and a 30-day trial, but a UK church needs current answers on pounds sterling, payment availability, Gift Aid and data-processing arrangements before adopting its giving or finance features.
bestFor: Churches wanting to trial an all-in-one operational platform
Teams that can audit how many people records they need to keep active
strengths: 30-day trial and core feature set are clearly published
Supplier explains its tracked-name billing model
limitations: Current subscription amounts need confirmation in the supplier selector
UK Gift Aid and payment workflows are not confirmed here

longForm.verdict: ChurchTrac is a broad operational suite whose price logic starts with the number of names a church tracks. The practical decision is whether its people, giving, planning and add-on model matches the church’s data and finance boundaries.

decisionLens.heading: Count the records the church needs before comparing a headline price.
decisionLens.text: ChurchTrac says every tracked person counts while archived names do not. That makes a short data audit and retention decision essential before comparing plan bands or beginning a migration.

sections.heading: An all-in-one trial
sections.question: Can one realistic workflow replace several separate tools?
paragraphs: ChurchTrac publishes people management, giving, website and app, check-in, groups, registrations, volunteer scheduling and worship planning. It also lists optional accounting and enhanced messaging.
Use the 30-day trial to build an event, rota, giving record and needed report. Confirm UK payment, Gift Aid and accounting hand-off before using live financial data.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not treat the supplier’s review claims as an independent rating. It is based on ChurchTrac’s published pricing and feature material.
themes: The tracked-name definition affects the subscription band.
Optional messaging and accounting need to be costed separately.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier claims and testimonials are not independent testing or a prediction of fit.

faq.question: Does ChurchTrac have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. ChurchTrac advertises a 30-day free trial. Use a non-sensitive test dataset until data-processing and migration terms are understood.

faq.question: How is ChurchTrac priced?
faq.answer: The supplier prices by tracked names, with optional accounting and enhanced-messaging add-ons. Use its current selector for the church’s actual count.

faq.question: Does ChurchTrac support UK Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Not confirmed in this profile. Ask the supplier to demonstrate UK payment, declaration, Gift Aid and finance-export workflows.
